mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for three consecutive months, it indicates a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust economic activity across multiple sectors, leading to higher corporate profits and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO increase, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or the Rank IC for the regime is below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending, which drives corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS increases, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output, reducing corporate profits and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100 for 2 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In recessionary labor market regimes (UNRATE > 5.5% and rising), unemployment growth erodes consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5% and rising, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a monetary policy response to economic weakness, which typically precedes a market rally as investors anticipate stimulus, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines and UNRATE rises, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.02 over 3-year windows.
